VirtualOutCmd.Title: Self-Consumption Optimization Level
VirtualOutCmd.Comment: Set the desired self-consumption optimization level. Level can be set to 0 (default mode) or between 1 and 3 (higher level = maximise the self-consumption optimization)

VirtualOutCmd.Title: Ventilation Control State
VirtualOutCmd.Comment: The following states are valid: None, BurstVentilation, CrossVentilation, VentilationLevel1, VentilationLevel2, VentilationLevel3, VentilationOff, VentilationAuto, VentilationAway

VirtualOutCmd.Title: Water Valve Flush
VirtualOutCmd.Comment: Activate the water valve (flush time in seconds)
